add_loss_arguments_to_parser: add loss-related CLI arguments to an argparse parser for disparity, depth ratio, and reprojection loss weights
configure_distance_function_type: configure the distance function type for static and smooth loss using l1 or other DIST_NAMES choices
set_loss_lambda_weights: set lambda weights for static disparity, depth ratio, reprojection, scene flow, and smoothness losses
generate_short_experiment_tag: generate a short experiment tag string summarizing static depth ratio, reprojection, and smooth loss weights
generate_full_experiment_tag: generate a full experiment tag string with all loss weights, distance type, alpha, scale, and parameter regularization
